Ethan: i'll pull the three calls and make a short CSV. columns: customer | ask | severity (low/med/high) | renewal_risk (yes/no/unclear) | quote | contact | triage (docs/eng/ops) | eta
Claire: add an enablement column (docs/train/runbook) and whether it's a demo-blocker.
Nadia: nice. keep entries one line each so product can skim.
Ethan: raw snippets below, will normalize:
- Meridian: onboarding step "connect model" times out after 60s, demo failed -> high, renewal mentioned, demo-blocker
- Emberly: customer wants per-route billing CSV export for finance -> med, unclear, docs-first
- Soto: bulk importer fails on >5k rows with 504 -> high, at-risk, endpoint `/v1/imports/csv`
Claire: i'll mark Emberly as docs-first and prep a short walkthrough. Meridian looks like engineering P0 if it's blocking demos.
prod-bot: Reminder: product sync 10am PT tomorrow  please add consolidated CSV as pre-read.
Ethan: CSV uploaded: <drive/link>  3 rows, added impact scores Meridian=5 Emberly=3 Soto=5 and call timestamps.
Nadia: action items: Ethan finalizes CSV by EOD, Claire drafts enablement playbook for Emberly, Nadia to ping product with digest. if eng needs logs for Soto, i'll attach recording and stack trace.
Ethan: attaching Soto log excerpt and endpoint in the CSV.

Nadia: thanks team  i'll deliver to product and update renewal tracker after their estimate. if anyone adds more notes, include call_ts + recording link.
